Manual test page for the Email Address Obfuscation plugin. See docs/testing.md. Each case states the expected result.

Email address

Plain-text email address

[obfuscate_email email="your@example.com"]

Expected: text your@example.com, not a link.

Clickable email address

[obfuscate_email email="your@example.com" link=true]

Expected: link your@example.com to mailto:your@example.com, no tooltip.

CSS classes

[obfuscate_email email="your@example.com" link=true class="my-class another-class"]

Expected: link with class="my-class another-class".

Email subject

Link

[obfuscate_email email="your@example.com?subject=My custom email subject" link=true class="my-class another-class"]

Expected: link text is only your@example.com; the email client opens with the subject My custom email subject.

Plain text

[obfuscate_email email='your@example.com?subject=My custom email subject']

Expected: text your@example.com?subject=My custom email subject (intended for use inside your own link).

Own link text

Email link click on it.

Expected: link Email link; the email client opens with the subject.

Email subject and body

[obfuscate_email email="your@example.com?subject=My custom email subject&body=Custom email body" link=true class="my-class another-class"]

Expected: the email client opens with the subject and the body Custom email body.

Invalid email addresses

[obfuscate_email link='true' email='xxx your@example.com '] [obfuscate_email link=true email="your@example"] [obfuscate_email link=true]

Expected: nothing is displayed between this line and the previous heading.

Phone number

Plain-text phone number

[obfuscate_phone phone="+421 000 000 000"]

Expected: text +421 000 000 000, not a link.

Clickable phone number

[obfuscate_phone phone="+421 000 000 000" link=true class="my-class"]

Expected: link +421 000 000 000 to tel:+421000000000 with class="my-class".

Own link text

Call us

Expected: link Call us to tel:+421000000000.

Invalid phone numbers

[obfuscate_phone phone="12" link=true] [obfuscate_phone phone="0800 FLOWERS" link=true] [obfuscate_phone link=true]

Expected: nothing is displayed between this line and the previous heading.

Security: CVE-2024-11935

Stored XSS via the class attribute, fixed in 1.1.0. Expected for all cases: no JavaScript alert when the page loads or when you click or tab to the links; in the developer tools the links have only href and class attributes, and class contains the whole text including onfocus.

Email

[obfuscate_email email="patch@example.com" link='true' class='test"autofocus tabindex=1 onfocus="alert(1)']

Email with subject

[obfuscate_email email="patch@example.com?subject=My custom email subject&body=Test" link='true' class='test"autofocus tabindex=1 onfocus="alert(1)']

Phone

[obfuscate_phone phone="+421 000 000 000" link='true' class='test"autofocus tabindex=1 onfocus="alert(1)']
